@graph.description: GenoCrate Study Dataset Profile: summarizes genomic datasets across multiple batch submissions, each conforming to the 'genomic-batch-submission' profile. This profile defines hierarchical structure, constraints, and documentation for study-level RO-Crates.
@graph.name: Genorate Study Dataset Profile
Hierarchy Overview
@graph.description: Data hierarchy: Root Dataset → Dataset → Collection → File. Each level references its children using 'hasPart'. Constraints specify requirements for each entity type.

@graph.name: Root Dataset Requirement
@graph.description: The root Dataset MUST use 'hasPart' to reference one or more unique 'Dataset' entities, as described in '#unique-dataset-rule'.

@graph.name: Identifier Dataset Requirement
@graph.description: Each Dataset MUST have an 'identifier' property for uniqueness, MUST reference at least one 'Collection' entity (see '#artifact-collection-rule'), and MUST mention entities representing its update history (see '#unique-dataset-history'), typically reflecting changes after each batch submission.

@graph.name: Dataset History Requirement
@graph.reviewBody: Each history entity '@id' is constructed as: <dataset-identifier>-<increment>. For each batch update, record: (1) type of change ('CreateAction', 'UpdateAction', 'DeleteAction'), (2) result (points to the unique artifact), (3) summary of the change, (4) endTime of the RO-Crate submission, and (5) actionStatus (indicating the result).

@graph.name: Artifact Collection Requirement
@graph.description: An artifact 'Collection' groups related artifacts and MUST reference one or more 'File' entities within the same category. Example: a VCF file and its index file form a single artifact collection. Assign '@id' using the identifier and artifact type (e.g., 'A001-vcf') for consistency.

@graph.name: File Requirement
@graph.description: This entity lists only the files included in the current batch submission, not all files present in the study RO-Crate directory. Only files specifically referenced from individual batch RO-Crates are included.
